scope: Existing Quant research history rendering; no engine, execution, Wallet SDK, Auth or release graph change
defect: Saved snapshot history bypassed the complete metric checks applied to new research results, could crash on a missing strategy/metrics and interpolated unverified metric strings into HTML
behavior: Use one identical complete-result metric validator for new results and saved history
Retain a visible localized unconfirmed row for malformed saved readback
Keep other valid history visible; allow explicit refresh and second launch to recover
Do not render sensitivity as a numeric spread unless it is a nonnegative safe integer
Do not fabricate a run, metric, trade, account, signature or public acceptance

tests.command: git diff --check; node --check apps/quant-lab/web/app.js; node --check apps/quant-lab/tests/business-flow.test.mjs; node --check apps/quant-lab/tests/browser.test.mjs

directLocalEvidence: Actual Chrome plus local Go server and controlled malformed snapshot fixtures: valid row survives, invalid rows localized, injected img absent, no pageerror, explicit refresh and reload recover, tab count=1 and POST count=0. Controlled Paper persistence fixtures separately exercise 2 tenants/2 processes/concurrent replay/restart. None is real Wallet authorization or official domain proof.
releaseDependency: A must integrate the owner source into the final compatible shared runtime and versioned asset graph and return source-bound official URL/version for owner verification
rollback: No production mutation occurred; A may omit this owner delta before release or use its signed previous immutable release after publication. Never reset user work.
